# Local GSAP files

Supply the genuine distribution files here, retaining their license notices:

- `gsap.min.js` — core (use a version supporting `gsap.matchMedia`, 3.11+).
- `ScrollTrigger.min.js` — scroll reveals, image expansion and sticky sequences.
- `Flip.min.js` — optional, prepared for future shared-element transitions.
- `SplitText.min.js` — optional; kinetic headings use whole-element motion without it.

Use matching versions from the official GSAP distribution. No library files are included or imitated. Existing files are detected and enqueued automatically; absent files never generate requests. Content and navigation remain usable without any of these files.
